text: Program Description Program overview Master in IBM based on teaching and research, complemented with practical application of learning during an internship period. Master in IBM was designed especially for international students who are interested in corporate management or international trade where business interaction with China is involved. Key modules: Profile of China, Basic Chinese, Chinese Economics and Political Regime, Econometrics, Strategy Management, Research Method, Management Information System, Microeconomics, Organizational Behavior etc. Tuition and Program Fee 35,000 RMB for one academic year.
